HG3_secondary.note: secondary; reported separately; does not change the verdict

verdict_rule: INCONCLUSIVE (n<30 or HG1 discordant<8) -> GATE-CONFIRMED (HG1, HG2, guard) -> GATE-HELPS-NOT-BEYOND-RULE (HG1, guard; HG2 fails if nonzero pairs<10) -> GATE-NOT-CONFIRMED
limits: West Tottori 2026 training rows contain many C4 misses (tau = 2 s: 15.4% > 10 km over 467 rows with C1), mostly early in the sequence when the past-event list is short, while the 91 21_02 evaluation events had 3.3%; rule R was already strong in 2026 (0.4% > 10 km), so HG2 (G beating R) is a hard test
test errors are rounded to 4 decimals (numpy round) before HG1/HG2, as were the training errors
the gate G was trained on one sequence (West Tottori 2026) and frozen before Northern Osaka 2018 was opened (22_00 section 7)
truth and past-event locations are JMA hypocentres; C1 can only return locations of past events, so neither C1 nor G can answer for an event in a new place
rule R's 10 km threshold was chosen after seeing Central Tottori 2016 and is fixed here in advance
feature 9 (P residual at the C4 epicentre) is missing with fewer than 3 P picks and is then filled with the training median
C1 and C4 errors are rounded to 4 decimals before comparison (as in the 21_20 CSV) so that ties stay ties
all 21_20 limitations apply (listed below, copied from 21_20 v1)

third sequence: Northern Osaka 2018 (mainshock 2018-06-18, 07:58 JST; origin time and Mj are those of the JMA catalogue, see 21_20a's JSON), never used in ARGUS development; the hypotheses were fixed on West Tottori 2026 (21_01/21_02), tested on Central Tottori 2016 (21_04, run with a documented deviation) and are applied here unchanged
one third sequence only

stations are NIED Hi-net (0101) only, chosen as the 50 nearest with data among the current NIED list; the West Tottori 2026 set of 50 stations also included non-Hi-net stations, so station types and geometry differ

waveforms were downloaded around catalogue events only and converted to the West Tottori 2026 h5 form (30-s windows, per-window per-component z-score, JST epoch); whether a filter was applied before the z-score in the 2026 h5 is not recorded (none here; compared in 21_20b G-spec)

the cache was built by 21_20c, whose picking, QC and assembly are identical to 15_01c v3.3 (itself identical to v3 except the window-index file name and output folder); 21_20c changed only labels, defaults and required arguments

catalogue: JMA hypocentres from h2018 (whether h2018 is the final stage is to be confirmed; West Tottori 2026 used the unified catalogue); past-event locations are JMA hypocentres (in operation: automatic slow-layer locations, possibly worse); truth is also JMA

the 2018 catalogue excludes matched-filter, undetermined/fixed (precision M, 8, 9; flag N, F), artificial and low-frequency events; whether the 2026 catalogue excluded them is not recorded. Manual and automatic hypocentres are mixed (per-flag counts in 21_20a's JSON)
station elevations are NIED's current height(m) (possibly the sensor depth for borehole stations); the 2026 station list's convention is not recorded; static station terms absorb a constant offset
offline PhaseNet picks on full records (possibly better than real-time picks); every method uses the same picks
cache keeps up to 24 stations per event (PhaseNet P first, earliest first); no not-yet-arrived information is used

cache waveforms had the full-window mean removed (includes future samples; removed by the 2 Hz high-pass except for a transient from the window start 3 s before P) and the source h5 is z-score normalised per 30-s window (the scale uses later samples of that window; cosine similarity is scale-invariant except where a window join falls inside the correlation window); the one-sample look-ahead of the cache's central-difference derivative is avoided by not using the last sample
no picking or telemetry latency (tau is ideal elapsed time)
the test events are small (1.5 <= Mj < 2.0); pick quality and station counts can differ from Mj >= 2.0 events
the 2-8 Hz band was chosen after seeing 18_01 on West Tottori 2026

C4's station terms come from past events' JMA hypocentres and truth is also JMA, so part of a C4 gain can be agreement with the JMA frame rather than better early information; C3all/C4all at all picks are reported to show this

C4 corrects only arrived stations held by >= 3 top similar events; each past event's terms are demeaned by its own median P residual over all its stations, while uncorrected stations keep only the static term
H1 (C3 at tau = 2 s) is the primary test; H2 and H3 are secondary at alpha 0.005; everything else is descriptive
